info.name: FoC Order Service
info.description:
AI Assistance Disclosure: Tool: Claude Code (model: Claude Opus 5.5), date: 2026-10-19. Scope: generated this collection from the routes and error codes in order-service/README.md. Author review: Reviewed

Requests for the Order Service. They go straight to the services (Order on port 3005), because the gateway does not route /orders yet.

SETUP: start the whole stack with `docker compose up -d --build`. Set emailA, emailB and password to two verified test accounts (A is the requester, B the courier; B must have no active order), and serviceKey to ORDER_SERVICE_KEY from your .env (folder 5 only). Then run folder 0. Access tokens last 15 minutes: run folder 0 again when requests start returning 401.

RUN each folder top to bottom (or with the Collection Runner). Each folder creates its own order, and each request saves orderId and version for the next one. Each order offers 1 credit. A full run needs A to have at least 5 available: folder 1 pays 1 to B, and a cancelled order's credit only returns about 10 s later, after the run has moved on. Credits never come back otherwise (closed economy), so if A runs low, swap the two accounts: B has been earning. Folder 1's last request waits 11 s for the credit settlement job.
